# Timeline

The Timeline is the main view. It draws templates, functions, queries and HTTP calls on one time axis, with nesting that shows who called what.

<!-- screenshot: timeline.png generated by e2e -->
![The Timeline waterfall with nested templates and queries](../assets/screenshots/timeline.png)

## What you can do

- Hover a row for details.
- Click a row to open a drawer with the full entry.
- Zoom and pan the time axis.
- Filter by type and search by text.
- Open the source file from any row in your editor.

Transactions appear as spans on the waterfall. Spans from custom panels can appear here with their own color and filter chip. See [Extending Lens](../guides/extending.md#spans).

All times are offsets from the start of the request.

## Settings

The Timeline needs `collectors.timeline.enabled`. Function spans need the opt-in `collectors.functions` collector. See [Configuration](../configuration.md#collectors).
